context: Two attributed review rounds show the security lens repeatedly reporting two generated API clients under src/generated. Each evidenced file identifies tools/codegen/templates/client.ts as its source, but the repository does not establish that every file in src/generated has that ownership. The package should stop reviewing the two generated copies for this concern while retaining review of the generator and all other security-sensitive source.
